verdict.rationale: Lever's marketing says it offers 'custom, flexible configurations' as opposed to 'standard, rigid workflows', which hints at configurable pipelines. Its Automation Hub automates advancing, archiving and tagging candidates, which only loosely relates to moving candidates through a pipeline. No evidence specifically documents custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, or bulk actions across the pipeline. Missing for 10: documented per-job custom stages, drag-and-drop candidate movement, bulk pipeline actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
